display.purpose: Hero name in the identity window; Silkscreen 700, used once per surface.

headline.purpose: Role line directly under the hero name; Silkscreen 400.

title.purpose: Window title bars, file names, entry heads, buttons; Silkscreen 700 at 0.72-0.85rem.

body.purpose: Paragraphs, file descriptions, menu items; Geneva-class 15px, measures of 52-68ch.

label.purpose: Menu-bar chrome, icon labels, status line, footer; Silkscreen 400 at 0.62-0.72rem.

shadows.name: window-shadow
shadows.purpose: Only depth in the system; sits under every window. Solid black, zero blur, zero alpha.

shadows.name: menu-popup-shadow
shadows.purpose: Under dropdown menus; the same hard offset one pixel closer.

motion.name: ants-march
motion.purpose: Marching-ants focus/selection ring: 8px dashes, 2px wide, drawn from four linear-gradient edges.

motion.name: boot-zoom-rect
motion.purpose: Boot sequence: three outlined rects (46/60/74vmin) scale 0.25 to 1, staggered 80ms, then the overlay is removed. Plays once.

motion.name: press-tick
motion.purpose: Instant button press displacement on :active; no transition.

motion.name: state-snap
motion.purpose: All inversion state changes (hover, focus, selection) apply with zero transition; 1-bit UI snaps, it does not fade.

breakpoints.name: stack-columns
breakpoints.purpose: min-width: stack section splits to two columns.

breakpoints.name: mobile-chrome
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: menus collapse into one Menu dropdown, windows stretch full-width, gutters 16px.

breakpoints.name: icon-rail
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: fixed desktop-icon rail hides; icons re-flow into a row inside the hero window.

components.name: Button
components.description: Standard pixel-labeled action; inverts on hover/focus, ticks 1px on press.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: var(--font-pixel); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.78rem; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; padding: 9px 20px; display: inline-block; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover, .ds-btn:focus-visible { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translate(1px, 1px); }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: The one primary action per view, wearing the classic double ring outside its 1px border.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { font-family: var(--font-pixel); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.78rem; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; padding: 9px 20px; display: inline-block; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-default:hover, .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); } .ds-btn-default:active { transform: translate(1px, 1px); }

components.name: Window
components.description: Signature container: black title bar with white close box, 1px chrome, hard 4px offset shadow.
components.html:
about.txt
Window content renders in Geneva 15px on white, with measures kept near 58-68ch.
components.css: .ds-window { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: var(--window-shadow); max-width: 440px; } .ds-titlebar { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 30px; padding: 0 8px; user-select: none; } .ds-titlebar-text { font-family: var(--font-pixel); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.72rem; flex: 1; text-align: center; margin-right: 22px; } .ds-close-box { width: 13px; height: 13px; border: 1px solid var(--paper); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; flex-shrink: 0; cursor: pointer; padding: 0; } .ds-close-box:hover { background: var(--paper); } .ds-window-body { padding: 28px 30px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Menu Bar
components.description: Fixed 30px top bar: pixel logo and menu titles on the left, Geneva minute clock on the right.
components.html: tanuv.infoFri 2:30 AM
components.css: .ds-menubar { height: 30px; background: var(--paper); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 0 10px; font-family: var(--font-pixel); font-size: 0.68rem; color: var(--ink); } .ds-menu-logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-weight: 700; padding: 4px 8px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; height: 100%; } .ds-menu-title { font-family: var(--font-pixel); font-size: 0.68rem; padding: 6px 10px; height: 100%; background: none; border: none; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-menu-title:hover, .ds-menu-title:focus-visible { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); outline: none; } .ds-clock { margin-left: auto; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.78rem; padding-right: 4px; }

components.name: Dropdown Menu
components.description: White popup with 1px border and 3px hard offset shadow; Geneva items invert on hover.
components.css: .ds-menu-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 3px 0; min-width: 150px; display: inline-block; background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); } .ds-menu-list a { display: block; padding: 7px 14px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; } .ds-menu-list a:hover, .ds-menu-list a:focus-visible { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); outline: none; }

components.name: File Row
components.description: The system's link table row: pixel icon, Silkscreen name, Geneva description, external arrow; whole row inverts on hover.
components.html: tm1goGo package wrapping the IBM TM1 REST API
components.css: .ds-file-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 13px 12px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0; } .ds-file-row svg { flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-file-name { font-family: var(--font-pixel); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.8rem; min-width: 96px; } .ds-file-desc { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.85rem; flex: 1; } .ds-file-arrow { margin-left: auto; } .ds-file-row:hover, .ds-file-row:focus-visible { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); outline: none; }

components.name: Desktop Icon
components.description: 32px two-color glyph over a paper label chip; hover/selected inverts both the glyph field and the label.
components.html: work
components.css: .ds-desk-icon { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 5px; width: 76px; padding: 6px 2px; text-align: center; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; } .ds-desk-icon svg { display: block; } .ds-desk-icon span { font-family: var(--font-pixel); font-size: 0.62rem; background: var(--paper); padding: 1px 4px; } .ds-desk-icon:hover svg, .ds-desk-icon:focus-visible svg { color: var(--paper); background: var(--ink); } .ds-desk-icon:hover span, .ds-desk-icon:focus-visible span { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); } .ds-desk-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selection Chip
components.description: Permanently inverted Silkscreen span for the availability status — a line that reads as already highlighted.
components.css: .ds-selection { font-family: var(--font-pixel); font-size: 0.72rem; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 0; }

components.name: Meta Tag
components.description: The dithered gray tag for dates and org lines: 25% stipple fill inside a 1px border.
components.css: .ds-meta-tag { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--ink); background-color: var(--paper); background-image: var(--stipple-25); border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; padding: 2px 6px; }

narrative.overview: The site is a 1984 Macintosh-class desktop rendered in pure one-bit graphics: black pixels and white pixels, nothing in between. It boots with a zoom-rect flourish into an already-open identity window, and every surface — menu bar, windows, dropdowns, desktop icons, file lists — speaks 1984 system-software grammar: black title bars with white close boxes, marching-ants selection, inverted press states, ordered dither instead of gray. Density is information-forward but airy: one staggered column of windows on a checkerboard desktop, generous gaps, small Geneva-class body text doing the reading while a pixel face runs the chrome. Motion ticks in steps() rather than gliding; state changes are instant inversions. The world has a single finish — there is no dark mode, no theme toggle, no color.
keyCharacteristics: Two values only: #000000 ink and #ffffff paper; ordered dither is the only gray
Silkscreen (self-hosted, OFL) for chrome and identity; Geneva-class sans for reading
1px black chrome everywhere; square corners with zero radius, no exceptions
One shadow: a 4px hard black offset under windows — the era's native depth
Inversion (ink-paper swap) as the universal hover / press / selection state
Marching ants as the focus and navigation-flash signal
Stepped, 1-bit motion: boot zoom-rect, ticking ants, 1px press displacement

rules.name: The Two Values Rule
rules.body: Black and white are the only values. There is no gray hex, no rgba() wash, no opacity blend, no accent color. If a surface needs a middle tone, use the checker or the 25% stipple — gray is a pattern here, never a value.

rules.name: The Inversion Rule
rules.body: The universal state change is a full ink-paper swap. Hover, press, selection, focus, and open menus all invert; nothing lightens, darkens, fades, or tints.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Identity and labels are Silkscreen; sentences are Geneva. Never set body paragraphs in the pixel face (it is illegible at length), and never set a title bar, button, or icon label in the body face (it stops sounding like the machine).

rules.name: The Staggered Desktop Rule
rules.body: Windows never form a flush full-width stack on desktop. Alternate the alignment, vary the width within the 560-760px band, and keep the 56px air between them — the scatter is the desktop metaphor.

rules.name: The Hard Offset Rule
rules.body: Shadows are solid black, offset down-right, zero blur, zero spread, zero alpha — 4px for windows, 3px for popups. Do not finish anything with a soft shadow; if it needs separation, use a 1px border or inversion.

rules.name: The Square Pixel Rule
rules.body: Radius is 0 on every surface, and all artwork snaps to the pixel grid. Do not round corners, soften edges, or drop in antialiased/glyph icons — crispEdges or nothing.

dos: Do express every hover, press, selection, and open state as a full ink-paper inversion — never a tint, fade, or opacity change.
Do keep all chrome at 1px black; the only depth is the 4px (windows) / 3px (popups) hard black offset.
Do reach for the checker or 25% stipple whenever a design wants gray — dither is the middle tone.
Do give the single primary action the double-ring default treatment (1px border + 2px outline, 2px offset).
Do author icons as 1-bit SVGs on a 16x16 grid, currentColor, crispEdges — and set text, never rasterize it.
Do run all animation in steps() and honor prefers-reduced-motion (boot off, ants frozen, instant scroll).
donts: Don't introduce a third value: no gray hexes, no rgba() blends, no hue, no opacity tricks.
Don't round any corner — radius is 0 on windows, buttons, chips, menus, and tags alike.
Don't add soft, blurred, or layered shadows; the hard offset is the only shadow the desktop knows.
Don't add a dark mode or theme toggle; the one-bit finish is the whole point, and inversion already means selection here.
Don't use eased tween transitions on UI chrome — state changes snap instantly, animation ticks in steps.
Don't substitute emoji, icon fonts, or antialiased SVGs for the authored pixel icon set.
